builds.hypothesis: Q5 melee formula(145+bonusAD)*(1.5+Stat9[statFormula=2]); explicit bonus-crit-damage scaling motivates IE while AD/armor penetration strengthen base. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

kitEvidence.formula:
Talon leaps to a target and deals [65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for [(65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1.5 + (1) × Stat(9)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage.

If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores [characterLevelInterpolation(9 → 55; raw flags preserved)] Health and refunds [50]% of its Cooldown.
